pricing.notes: Campus/online mode, residency and degree-specific charges vary; no universal tuition amount is asserted.

institutional.notes: ASU evaluates traditional coursework documented on transcripts from regionally accredited colleges and universities. A maximum 64 lower-division semester hours normally applies to community/junior/two-year college credit, with exceptions. Applicability to a chosen degree is separate; no universal 90-credit cap was established in this review.

ace.notes: The official ACE FAQ says ACE recommendations are not used to evaluate domestic or international institutional courses. This does not by itself resolve every military/training or noncollege-provider category. Sophia/Study.com applicability was not independently verified and must not be labeled accepted.

nccrs.notes: No NCCRS acceptance policy was established in this bounded review.

graduate.notes: ASU directs graduate students to Graduate College pre-admission-credit policies; undergraduate transfer rules cannot be applied to graduate degrees.
